verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms RustDesk publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200) with substantive product content, including capabilities, server editions, plan features and Wayland support. That satisfies the story's 'llms.txt or agent-oriented docs' requirement. missing for 10: markdown/agent-readable doc page variants (the /docs/en/.md probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Remote view and control, unattended access with a permanent password, file transfer in both directions, in-session text chat, and session recording.
Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
